title: The Clean Contact
author: Yara Nakamura
blurb: Gideon Nystrom, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
